definitions.explanation: Steel — an alloy of iron and carbon. Used literally for the material and figuratively to describe something strong and unyielding.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鋼|はがね}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This kitchen knife is made of steel.

examples.japanese: {鋼|はがね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: He overcame the difficulty with a will of steel.

examples.japanese: {日本刀|にほんとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鋼|はがね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{折|お}り{重|かさ}ねて⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧ことで、⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧⟦{切|き}れ{味|あじ}→切れ味：19110_kireaji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese swords achieve their sharp cutting edge by repeatedly folding and forging steel.

notes:
The native Japanese word for steel. Also read as こう in Sino-Japanese compounds like ⟦{鉄鋼|てっこう}→鉄鋼：17369_tekkou⟧ (iron and steel).

USAGE:
{鋼|はがね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような～ (like steel) is used to describe exceptional strength or toughness: {鋼|はがね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧ (iron will), {鋼|はがね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{肉体|にくたい}→肉体：13912_nikutai⟧ (body of steel).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鋼|はがね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧ (will of steel)
- {鋼|はがね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧ (steel blade)
- {鋼|はがね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧ (to forge steel)

Well known from the manga title {鋼|はがね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{錬金術師|れんきんじゅつし} (Fullmetal Alchemist).
